title: Longleaf Pines
meta_description: Longleaf Pines -- Pet-friendly, four-bedroom retreat in gated Blue Mountain community with pool, playground, bikes, balcony, and beach access nearby.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Serenity is what you will feel as soon as you drive through the gates of this coastal neighborhood and along the tree lined streets. Welcome to Longleaf Pines in the Lake Forest neighborhood of Blue Mountain. This lovely home and neighborhood is so peaceful you may forget about your life back home and that's what we hope you'll do for as long as you are here. Longleaf Pines is perfect for a multigenerational family or multiple families with four (4) bedrooms, one being on the first floor. Its elegant yet comfortable furnishings say sit back, relax and enjoy the beach.

\*\*\*GATED COMMUNITY\*\*\*

\*\*\* PET FRIENDLY \*\*\*

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain is one of the 30A coastal communities that rests between Gulf Place and Grayton Beach. The Blue Mountain community is known for having a quieter family atmosphere compared to some of the other communities but still provides ample restaurants, shops and activities.

BEACH ACCESS: Gulfview Heights beach access is less than 1 mile and is the closest to Longleaf Pines. Turn right on 30A and then left at Gulfview Heights Street. It has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season. You can also go East to Blue Mountain Regional Access. There is some parking and restrooms.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King bed with ensuite bath -- 1st Floor
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen bed with ensuite bath -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 3 -- King bed with ensuite and sitting room -- 2nd Floor
• Bedroom 4 -- (1) Twin/Twin bunk bed -- 2nd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gated Community
• Community Pool and Clubhouse
• Children's playground, walking trails
• 2 Adult Bikes
• Balcony with comfortable seating
• Soaker tub in upstairs master suite
• Gas stove in kitchen
• Red Egg charcoal smoker on the side patio
• TV's throughout
• Self-Check-In
• Full size washer and dryer
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Guests are required to comply with the Forest Lakes Neighborhood Summary of Rules, or house rules will be available in the home upon arrival.
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- Bikes may only be in the driveway or the garage, you may not leave them on the porch
- Towels may not be hung over the railings; there are towel hooks in the driveway, additional a drying rack in the garage

Parking Details:
- Only two cars are allowed in the driveway.
- Parking placards will be issued for the total number of permitted vehicles, including LSVs, and must be displayed at all times.
- Additional vehicles must be parked outside the community. Renters may park only at the rented property, not in overflow areas.
- A minimum $100 fine will be applied for cars parked overnight on the street.
- Vehicles must not block sidewalks.
- Vehicles must not park on pine straw.
- If a golf cart is rented, you may only have a golf cart and one other car in the driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
